lines: At beginning of sacrifice, in its middle, at its conclusion; in reflection on knowledge and yoga, in cessation of obstacles, in cutting of bonds; of mudrā procedure proper time.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yāgādau tanmadhye tadavasitau jñānayogaparimarśe vighnapraśame pāśacchede mudrāvidheḥ samayaḥ
